clips.send: Someone chasing a mentor's current routine sends this to a friend making the same mistake - relief at finally knowing what's actually worth copying.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says people ask him the wrong question constantly.

They want his daily routine today - what he eats, when he wakes up, how he spends his hours now. Kevin Trudeau says that's useless information.

His rule: don't study someone at cruising altitude. Study them on the runway. A pilot doesn't fly at takeoff the way he flies at 35,000 feet - full throttle, flaps down, brakes held until the exact RPM. Business works the same way. What you do in year one has nothing to do with what you do once you're already flying.

If you want to copy someone successful, stop asking what they do now. Ask what they did when they were exactly where you are.

clips.send: Someone who's been 'wanting' the same thing for years without ever writing it down sends this to themselves, really - the jolt of being called a wishful thinker, not a dreamer.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people aren't dreamers. They're wishful thinkers, and there's a real difference.

A dream that only exists as a feeling in your head isn't a dream yet, he says. It becomes real the moment it's specific: a number, a date, a result you could write down and hand to someone else.

Kevin Trudeau's test: can you quantify it? Can you measure it? Have you actually written it down? If not, you don't have a goal. You have a wish floating in the air, and wishes alone don't build anything.

Have you ever actually written your biggest goal down, in specific numbers?

#kevintrudeau #yourwishisyourcommand #manifestation #goalsetting #mindset #successmindset
